findings.stage_challenged: distractor repair (q4 A refutability) + rationale precision
findings.claim: The q4 rationale over-attributes the moth inventory to the fourteen study meadows. It says the passage does not license option A because 'the fourteen sites were picked as likartade slaatterangar and paired by size and flower richness, and an earlier inventory had caught mer an sextio arter av nattfjarilar ON THEM'. The passage does not say that: the inventory sentence sits in paragraph 3, before the fourteen sites are introduced in paragraph 4, and its referent 'pa just dessa angar' points back to the Klovsater meadows of the lede (the ones nearest the lamp row), not to the fourteen-site sample.
findings.evidence: Passage para 3: 'I en tidigare inventering hade hennes grupp fangat mer an sextio arter av nattfjarilar pa just dessa angar'. The fourteen meadows first appear in para 4: 'For att prova saken valde forskarna ut fjorton likartade slatterangar i samma trakt.' questions[3].rationale, sentence on option A, attaches the inventory to the fourteen sites. Consequence for probe 1: distractor A ('De hade sa fa nattfjarilar att en slackning inte kunde ge nagot matbart utslag dar') is refuted mainly by the selection wording 'likartade slatterangar' plus the matched pairing, not by the inventory count; and species richness is in any case not abundance.
findings.why: Not refutation-grade. A remains beatable from the passage and the blind solvers on both G-KEY votes picked B with text-anchored justifications, and G-DISTRACTOR-distfix independently classified A as ARGUABLE-but-beatable (flag, not kill). But the rationale is the teaching payload; it currently cites a warrant the passage does not supply. One-clause fix: drop 'on them' or rewrite as 'an earlier inventory on these meadows had caught mer an sextio arter'.

findings.stage_challenged: distractor repair - liveness and passage-only refutability (probe 1)
findings.claim: All four rewritten options are live for a passage-blind reader and each is refuted by a specific passage sentence rather than by its own form.
findings.evidence: q1 A 'Ljusfallorna fangade fler fjarilar vid de morklagda angarna, men frosattningen hos skymningsglim lag kvar pa samma nivo' - a mixed two-measure outcome is exactly what a real study can report, and it half-echoes the critic's objection; refuted only by para 5 'Pa de morklagda narangarna steg dessutom frosattningen hos skymningsglim med i genomsnitt en femtedel'. q1 B 'Slackningen fick antalet nattfjarilar att mer an fordubblas vid angarna narmast lampraden' - right direction and right location, one quantity claim and no stacked absolutes; refuted only by the lede 'okat med omkring en tredjedel'. q4 A 'De hade sa fa nattfjarilar att en slackning inte kunde ge nagot matbart utslag dar' - a standard low-power explanation of a null result; beaten by 'fjorton LIKARTADE slatterangar' + the matched pairing (see the minor above on its rationale). q4 D 'De bor ha blivit samre for fjarilarna, eftersom insekterna nu drogs till de morklagda angarna narmare lampraden i stallet' - a coherent zero-sum redistribution worry, no longer self-refuting; refuted only by 'langre bort gick ingen forandring att matta'. Form check I ran myself: none of the four contains a stacked absolute, none contains a proper noun, and the pick-the-longest tell is gone - by characters the longest option is q1 A (120 vs key D 118), q2 B (128 vs key A 125), q3 B (124 vs key C 118), q4 D (122 vs key B 120), so the key is the unique longest in zero of four; by word count the note's 'ties' reading also holds (q2 A=B=19, q3 B=C=18).
findings.why: Probe 1 answers yes on both halves. Independently corroborated by both blind G-KEY-distfix votes landing on the keys with passage-anchored justifications and by G-DISTRACTOR-distfix rating the two surviving competitors (q3 A, q4 A) ARGUABLE-and-beatable rather than DEFENSIBLE.

findings.claim: No name in the current unit has a real bearer in the relevant domain, and round 3 introduced no name at all.
findings.evidence: Broad-web sweep run through Exa (WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted; DuckDuckGo html returned HTTP 403 to scripted queries). 'skymningsglim': no bearer anywhere - results are real congeners only (Backglim / Silene nutans, Nattglim / Silene noctiflora) and seed-shop pages for them. 'Malin Selmerlund ekolog': no bearer; results are unrelated Swedish ecologists (Malin White, Malin Celander, Malin Lundberg, Malin Soderlund, Malin Ysterfors). 'Korseberg': the surname exists (Lene Kirstine Korseberg, a Norwegian higher-education/law researcher at NIFU; a genealogy site) but no entomologist and no Nils Korseberg; sv.wikipedia's 15 'Korseberg' hits are all Vanersborg-area toponymy. 'Bjallerup': sv.wikipedia's 44 hits are all Staffanstorp-area toponymy (Bjallerup, Stora/Lilla Bjallerup); the only person-like hit is a differently spelled 'Cornelia Bjellerup' in finance; no Torsten Bjallerup. 'Klovsater': sv.wikipedia 0, Wikidata 0, Nominatim []. 'Skaraborg' is real and used truthfully as geography.
findings.why: Probe 4 satisfied first-hand rather than by trusting the repair log or my own earlier round.

findings.claim: My round-2 note that the coined name should have used the 'blara' morpheme rather than 'glim' is weaker than it read; 'glim' is in fact the apt morpheme for this syndrome.
findings.evidence: Backglim (Silene nutans) - a real Swedish meadow Silene in the glim group - has white petals that stay rolled up by day and unfurl at dusk, emits a strong scent at night, and is described in Swedish sources as pollinated exclusively by nattfjarilar and other night insects (sv.wikipedia 'Backglim'; wiki.plantae.se 'Silene nutans'; runeberg.org Nordens Flora tavl. 340). So a coined dusk-opening, white, night-scented meadow 'glim' sits inside an existing Swedish naming pattern rather than against it. The only property that has no glim model is dioecy, which is why the invented plant is invented.
findings.why: Recorded so the orchestrator does not act on a stale recommendation from my previous file. The bearer-freeness of 'skymningsglim' is unaffected and re-confirmed above.
